violations.text: The following sanitizing solutions were observed not testing in proper range: - The quaternary ammonium concentration in the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay sink was 0 parts per million (ppm). At the time of inspection, the tubing to the chemical was adjusted and primed. Quaternary ammonium sanitizing solution was retested at 200-400 ppm after adjustment. - The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Per the PIC, all equipment/utensils to be properly sanitized in the 3-bay sink until serviced. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/14/2026

Food items in the prep unit across from fryolators was observed holding food temps at 44-45degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Food items were moved to the walk-in cooler for rapid cooling at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/14/2026

Recently prepped fries in the prep unit across from the fryolators were observed at 55-60 degrees Fahrenheit. Per the PIC, fries were cooked prior to opening. Proper cooling strategies were reviewed with the PIC. Fries were moved to the walk-in cooler for rapid cooling at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/14/2026

The following equipment were observed in need of repair/asjustment: - The prep unit across from the fryolator was observed with standing water in the base and maintaining an ambient temperature of 48-50 degrees Fahrenheit with foods observed at 44-45 degrees Fahrenheit. All foods were removed and unit was taken out of service. Call was made for replacement of unit at the time of inspection. - The faucet to the 3 bay sink was observed leaking from the hot water control during use - The faucet to the hand sink near the kitchen-to-dining exit was observed leaking from the water controls unit during time of use Equipment is to be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 10/28/2026
Ceiling tiles were observed stained (water stains from previous leak). Ceiling tiles are to be replaced when stained and no longer in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 10/28/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener) was observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 09/17/2025

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Please email inspector proof of certification. New Violation. Correct By: 04/25/2024
The floor in the walk-in freezer has an accumulation of ice. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 04/25/2024
